task: Relabel all my P1 and P2 email threads with priority-1 and priority-2, respectively, and remove all P3 labels.

emails.subject: Dinner Party RSVP
emails.body:
Hi all!

 I'm hosting a dinner party next week and would love for you to join. Please RSVP by the end of the week so I can finalize the guest list. Looking forward to seeing you all there!

Cheers,
Ashlee
